_doc: HOME closes the AI sheet while the AI key is still held (audit AUD2-001): the capture ends at the close, the turn's answer is dropped.

ai.capture_cancelled.why: closing the sheet must end the running capture

audio.mic.captured_ms.why: the microphone stops at the close (1.5 s into the 4 s hold), not at the release or never

ai.release_to_first_audio_heard_ms.count.why: no answer audio after the sheet was closed

rt.closed.why: also when the sheet was closed with the key still held
